commitments.target: rail business, I'm expecting this year to grow by around 20%, 25%
commitments.quote: So rail business, I'm expecting this year to grow by around 20%, 25% because of these coming in.
commitments.speaker: Ramesh Kunhikannan

claims.claim: Total revenue stood at INR3,626.4 crores, reflecting a year-on-year growth of 33.2%.
claims.quote: Our total revenue stood at INR3,626.4 crores, reflecting a year-on-year growth of 33.2%.

claims.claim: EBITDA for FY 26 was INR5,741 million, registering 39.8% growth and translating to 15.8% margin.
claims.quote: Our EBITDA for the period FY '26 was INR5,741 million, registering a growth of 39.8% over the same period last year. This translates into an EBITDA margin of 15.8% for FY '26

claims.claim: Profit after tax came in at INR3,639 million, representing a PAT margin of 10% for FY 26.
claims.quote: while profit after tax came in at INR3,639 million, representing a PAT margin of 10% for FY '26.

claims.claim: Core EMS working capital days reduced from 83 days in FY 24 to 53 days in FY 26.
claims.quote: On a like-to-like basis, we would like to bring it to your attention that the core EMS business has demonstrated a significant improvement in the efficiency as committed earlier with the working capital days reducing from 83 days in FY '24 to 53 days in FY '26.

claims.claim: Near-term top line performance was impacted by geopolitical disruption leading to deferments.
claims.quote: Near-term top line performance did not fully meet market expectations, primarily due to geopolitical disruption, especially the West Asia conflict, which led to last-minute customer deferment, supply chain delays and product timing shift.

claims.claim: One of the largest electric vehicle OEM manufacturers dropped revenue by about 90%.
claims.quote: And one of the largest electric vehicle OEM manufacturers has completely dropped by about 90% of the revenue, wherein we were the single supplier which has dropped our numbers.

analyst_concerns.question: Pressed on the vast variance between expected versus delivered numbers and guidance sanctity.
analyst_concerns.quote: Sir, how should, as investors, we look at this guidance? And what is the sanctity of the guidance that we are providing, sir? Because there is a very vast variance between what was expected versus what is delivered, sir?

analyst_concerns.question: Raised concern over a large negative operational cash flow against prior guidance.
analyst_concerns.quote: Sir, OCF INR600 crores of negative, I think that is a bigger disappointment, especially when you kind of guided that you will be just about neutral or slightly negative, sir.

analyst_concerns.question: Queried about the increase in receivables and lack of progress on securitization in the metering subsidiary.
analyst_concerns.quote: Because sir, I think this is exactly same from what was given in last quarter concall. So there is no progress in this quarter at all in this?

analyst_concerns.question: Asked about the key reasons for the increase in intangible assets from FY25 to FY26 balance sheet.
analyst_concerns.quote: In balance sheet, the intangible asset in FY '25 was INR238 crores. And in FY '26, it is INR536 crores. So what was the INR300 crores increase? What was the key reason for that?
